Or who fathers the drops of dew?” (web:Job.38.28), and מִבֶּ֣טֶן מִ֭י יָצָ֣א הַקָּ֑רַח, “Whose womb did the ice come out of? boundary_rationale: This row closes the cosmos catalog across two interior turns. הַֽ֭תְקַשֵּׁר מַעֲדַנּ֣וֹת כִּימָ֑ה, “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?” (web:Job.38.31), opens the constellations item on a patah-plus-meteg interrogative-he (not the more common hataf-patah spelling; the same patah-plus-meteg spelling recurs only at its sibling verse inside this row, 38:35 — sweep: 2 within the 38:16-39:12 catalog window; book-wide the spelling occurs in 9 verses (8 interrogative)), running through the heavens' laws at verse 33 (“Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?”, web:Job.38.33). הֲתָרִ֣ים לָעָ֣ב קוֹלֶ֑ךָ, “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?” (web:Job.38.34) turns to weather and, at verse 36, to a bare מִי שָׁ֭ת בַּטֻּח֣וֹת חָכְמָ֑ה, “Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?” (web:Job.38.36) — the catalog's turn toward wisdom, a two-verse pair rather than one event: מִֽי יְסַפֵּ֣ר שְׁחָקִ֣ים בְּחָכְמָ֑ה, “Who can count the clouds by wisdom?” (web:Job.38.37), repeats the same bare-מי wisdom opener immediately after. The whole cosmos catalog then closes on the mundane image of dust caking into clods (“when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?”, web:Job.38.38), before verse 39 opens the animal catalog with a fresh interrogative aimed at the lioness. The he-interrogative opener recurring across this whole span is texture, not the discriminator by itself: fifteen verses open on it between 38:16 and 39:12, of which five run consecutively inside this row alone (31-35); this row's own edges rest instead on the topic shifts named above — constellations, weather, wisdom, dust.
strongest_rejected_alternative: Ending the cosmos catalog at verse 33 with the constellations, so that 34-38's weather-and-wisdom material would open a fresh row, was considered. No speech or scene marker separates 38:33 from 38:34 — but by that same test no speech or scene marker separates 38:30 from 38:31 or 38:38 from 38:39 either, so the criterion cannot be what distinguishes this row's own edges from the rejected seam; the ground here is instead the topic continuity of 31-38 as one movement through the sky's phenomena, closing on dust before the animal catalog's fresh subject at 39.
literature_type_guess: Constellations and heaven's laws turning through weather to inward wisdom, closing on dust and clods

The narrower two-member device this shape recalls, the gird-up formula's own two-word core כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ (sweep: 2 book-wide, 38:3 and 40:7 only), does not reach 40:10 at all and sits entirely before this row's near edge, so it argues nothing about the 40:9|40:10 seam either way.
